description.value: The study used optimised voxel based morphometry and manual region of interest tracing to compare brain atrophy patterns in autopsy-proven FTLD-T and FTLD-U with cognitively normal controls.

Fourteen patients with pathological FTLD and 61 cognitively normal controls were studied using their earliest brain MRIs; patients were autopsy proven and controls had no neurological or psychiatric history.

value: Compared with controls, FTLD-T patients had atrophy in the right inferior frontal gyrus, left head of caudate/anterior putamen and right putamen after correction for multiple comparisons.
Compared with healthy controls, FTLD-T showed gray matter loss in frontal cortices and striatum bilaterally, as well as anterior temporal regions.
